name: WA Women in Trades Scholarship ($5,000)
provider: Jobs and Skills WA (Government of Western Australia)
summary: A $5,000 scholarship for women starting eligible apprenticeships, traineeships or trade qualifications at WA TAFE colleges.
key: A $5,000 scholarship payment for eligible women.
who: Women enrolling in eligible apprenticeships, traineeships or qualifications at WA TAFE colleges
Full-time and part-time enrolments are eligible
how: Apply through your WA TAFE college; more information at tafe.wa.edu.au.
catches: 100 scholarships available in 2026, available until places are filled.
Training must start between 1 January 2026 and 31 December 2026 (per South Regional TAFE).

source.label: Jobs and Skills WA: Women in Trades Scholarship Program 2026 now open

commence training in an eligible qualification (full time or part time) between 1 January 2026 and 31 December 2026
